The plate is square, roughly 22 cm across, so I treated it as a side-to-dinner plate. All weights are estimates from how much of the plate each item covers and how tall it looks.

- **Scrambled eggs:** They cover about 30% of the plate, roughly 130 cm², and are about 3 cm high. That comes to around 140 g.
- **Broccoli:** It covers about 12% of the plate and looks roughly 3 cm tall, but it is loosely packed. I estimated 50 g.
- **Sweet potato:** There are a few roasted cubes, about 5 cubes of roughly 15 g each, so about 70 g.
- **Blackberries:** I counted about 6 berries at roughly 5 g each, so about 30 g.
- **Strawberries:** There are 4 small pieces, about 25 g in total.
